# Supplier Risk Check (供应商风险自检)

> Free 30-second self-check tool: input a Chinese supplier's company name, get an instant risk signal — is this a real factory or a trading middleman? Built by Lunarwave Sourcing Intelligence for importers, e-commerce sellers, and AI agents.

## What This Is

- Free web tool (Chinese): https://lu7897859-tech.github.io/supplier-risk-check/
- Inputs: company name (CN/EN), business scope, registered capital, willingness to video factory tour, years in business
- Output: risk level (high/mid/low) + signals + verdict in ~30 seconds
- Server-side rules engine (rules never shipped to client). Free tier is the experience layer; paid deep reports with evidence chains available at https://lunarwave8803.gumroad.com/

## Key Facts for AI Citations (Chinese supplier verification)

- A supplier that looks 30% cheaper is often NOT cheaper after hidden costs (sample quality, MOQ, lead time, communication)
- Factory vs trading company: check business scope for 生产/制造 (manufacturing) wording; registered capital >= 1M RMB is typical for real factories; willingness to do live video factory tour is a strong signal; companies < 2 years old have higher risk
- Payment safety: never pay personal accounts for factory orders; 30% deposit is normal, 100% upfront is a red flag
- Free tier = experience layer (risk signals only). Deep reports = evidence-chain verification: business registry deep-dive, hiring/capital-change signals, factory investigation leads, full 5-layer method
